content.text: No liquidated damages or penalty provisions payable by the Licensee appear anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, DAMAGES FOR THE LOSS OF GOODWILL, PROSPECTIVE PROFITS OR ANTICIPATED INCOME, OR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM ANY EXPENDITURES, INVESTMENTS, LEASES OR COMMITMENTS MADE BY EITHER PARTY ON ACCOUNT OF THE TERMINATION OR EXPIRATION OF THIS AGREEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS TERMS.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, early-termination fee or minimum/accelerated fee on the Licensee, so it meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages). The payment provisions (Articles V and the fee schedule, p0050–p0074, p0086) are usage-based license, support and supplemental payments only, with no shortfall charge or penalty interest. Article XXIII (p0142) expressly bars termination damages for both parties, and Article XXI (p0138) requires only return of the Licensed Technology on termination. Article IV (p0049) preserves the Licensor's right to "receive payments for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" after termination, which is payment for services actually used rather than a liquidated sum, and the audit cost-shift in p0064 (triggered only by a discrepancy over 5%) is a cost-reimbursement mechanic, not a penalty. Noted only for the record: there is no service-credit or vendor-side remedy running to us, but that is outside this rule.
